summary:
ASTRO-SHIELD is an innovative web-based Health Monitoring Software designed to support astronauts during space missions. Space exploration brings many challenges to human health due to microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, and changes in daily routines. These conditions can affect astronauts' heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, hydration, and sleep patterns. To address these challenges, ASTRO-SHIELD provides a digital platform that helps monitor important health indicators and supports astronauts in maintaining their well-being. Its main aim is to make health monitoring simple, accessible, and efficient, even in the challenging environment of outer space.

The system includes several useful features such as Heart Rate Monitoring, Blood Pressure Monitoring, Body Temperature Monitoring, Hydration Reminder, Sleep Monitoring, and Health Alerts. It provides a centralized dashboard where health information can be viewed in an organized manner. The alert system displays notifications when recorded readings cross predefined limits, while hydration reminders encourage astronauts to drink water regularly. The website is developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML creates the website structure, CSS provides an attractive design, and JavaScript adds interactive functionality, reminders, and notifications. These features help make the website user-friendly and informative.
